title: Smoothness and derivative of parametric integrals over [0, 1]
statement: Let N ∈ ℕ, let V be a complete real normed space (V : Type), and let h : ℝ × ℝ^N → V be C^∞ (ContDiff ℝ ∞, written ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞)), where ℝ^N = EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin N). Then F(x) := ∫_0^1 h(t, x) dt (interval integral) is C^∞ on ℝ^N. Moreover, for every x ∈ ℝ^N, F has Fréchet derivative ∫_0^1 D[x' ↦ h(t, x')](x) dt at x. This derivative is the interval integral in L(ℝ^N, V) of the partial derivatives fderiv ℝ (fun x' => h (t, x')) x.
lean_statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) (V : Type) [NormedAddCommGroup V] [NormedSpace ℝ V] [CompleteSpace V] (h : ℝ × Euclid N → V), ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) h → ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) (fun x : Euclid N => ∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1, h (t, x)) ∧ ∀ x : Euclid N, HasFDerivAt (fun x' : Euclid N => ∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1, h (t, x')) (∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1, fderiv ℝ (fun x' : Euclid N => h (t, x')) x) x
